Subject: Sales discovery: legal & procurement routing - ACME (NDA/MSA/DPA sequencing)

Hi Emma & Tom,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great discussion and excited about the potential pilot scope. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have alignment on stakeholders and contract routing: 

Call recap / stakeholders
- Economic / executive sponsor: Emma Lawson (Dir of Product) — driving business requirements and ROI metrics.
- Technical owner: Tom Rivera (Head of AI/ML) — responsible for integration & performance acceptance.
- Legal lead: Tony Nguyen (ACME Legal) — will own NDA + MSA redlines.
- Procurement: procurement@acme.com — will own purchase order / PO and vendor setup.

Contract sequencing (recommended)
1) NDA (mutual) — sign to enable data/POCs.
2) Pilot SOW / statement of work (technical scope + success metrics).
3) MSA + DPA redline sequencing (MSA to cover broader commercial terms; DPA if we will process regulated data).
4) Procurement PO / vendor onboarding once SOW + commercial terms agreed.

What we need from ACME
- Confirm legal and procurement owners (email aliases are fine) and expected turn times for NDA and MSA redlines.
- Any standard clauses or procurement checklist we should be aware of (e.g., insurance limits, IP carve-outs, data residency).

Attachments: I attached a short NDA draft and our MSA redline template to start the conversation (ACME_NDA_draft_20270401.pdf, Redwood_MSA_redline_v1.docx). Also including a one-page pilot SOW template if helpful.

Proposed next step
- Can we schedule a 30-min sync with Tony + ACME procurement next week to align on sequencing and expected legal turn times? I’m available Tue 4/6 between 2:00–4:00pm PT.

If you prefer, Rishi (cc’d) can join to walk through common redline items and turn-time expectations from our side.

Thanks,

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. Quick answers from our side: 

Stakeholder confirmations
- I’ll be the exec sponsor and own the business sign-off.
- Tom is the technical owner and will coordinate the pilot SOW.
- Tony Nguyen (t.nguyen@acme.com) is our legal lead and will own NDA/MSA review. I’m looping him in.
- Procurement: procurement@acme.com (cc’d) will manage PO process and vendor setup.

Turn times / expectations
- NDA: typically 1–3 business days for our initial legal review (unless there are non-standard IP clauses).
- MSA: 7–15 business days depending on complexity and whether our procurement requests changes to payment/insurance terms.
- Procurement PO: once SOW and commercial terms are agreed, PO issuance is usually 3–7 business days.

I attached our procurement checklist (ACME_procurement_checklist.xlsx) for visibility — it lists typical items we surface to vendors. Tony, if you want to jump on a 30-min sync to align sequencing, we’re available Tue 4/6 2:00–3:00pm PT.

Emma/Tony/procurement team — thank you for the quick responses and the checklist. Confirming next steps and our proposed sequencing based on your guidance: 

1) NDA (mutual) — we’ll send the attached NDA draft for Tony’s review. Estimated turnaround: 2–3 business days if no unusual clauses.
2) Pilot SOW — Tom, request: can you share a 1-page scope by EOD 4/4 so we can include acceptance criteria in the SOW?
3) MSA redline sequencing — once NDA + SOW are in flight, we’ll exchange MSA redlines. Based on your note, expect 7–10 business days typical, but we’ll flag any commercial terms early (insurance, payment terms, IP).
4) Procurement / PO — after SOW + commercial terms agreed, PO typically 3–7 business days.

Action items
- Tony: please confirm if the NDA draft is an acceptable starting point and whether your team has any mandatory clauses we should preemptively address.
- Tom: please share the 1-page pilot scope by EOD 2027-04-04.
- Procurement: confirm any additional vendor setup fields we’ll need to submit with the PO.
- Rishi & Dev (cc’d) — we can provide a short redline playbook and common clause language to speed reviews.

If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite for Tue 4/6 2:00pm PT for the legal + procurement sync (30 min) and include the NDA/MSA attachments in the invite.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to getting the pilot launched.
